name: Yellowstone River (Gardiner)
blurb: Whitewater stretch out of the Park boundary. Rafts and experienced paddlers.

sections.notes: Continuous wave trains at higher flows. Not a tube float.
sections.accessReview: A suitable launch at Queen of the Waters and the intended Corwin Springs landing have not been confirmed for this listing.

notices.title: Corwin Springs / Brogan’s Landing closure record
notices.text: FWP’s site linked from the older Corwin Springs map is now named Brogan’s Landing. Its current record still lists a flood-related emergency closure effective July 1, 2022 until further notice. Do not use that old map or the tourism listing as proof of an open boat launch.

sections.mapPendingReason: A suitable launch at Queen of the Waters and the intended Corwin Springs landing have not been confirmed for this listing.

sections.notes: Cinnabar to Carbella passes through Yankee Jim Canyon. Experienced whitewater boaters only; inspect conditions and arrange the shuttle before launching. Both map markers are facility-area references. The older Corwin Springs/Brogan’s launch is not used.

notices.title: Carbella camping restriction
notices.text: BLM restricts camping at Carbella to hard-sided units through December 31, 2026 because of grizzly activity. Check the current notice before an overnight stay.

notices.title: Corwin Springs / Brogan’s Landing closure record
notices.text: FWP’s site linked from the older Corwin Springs map is now named Brogan’s Landing. Its current record still lists a flood-related emergency closure effective July 1, 2022 until further notice. Do not use that old map or the tourism listing as proof of an open boat launch.

notices.title: Launch changed to Cinnabar
notices.text: FWP identifies Cinnabar as a separate USFS launch option downstream of Brogan’s Landing. The map now uses that named facility, with approximate access locations. The old trip distance has not been carried forward as verified and float-time estimates remain disabled.
notices.sourceName: Montana FWP — Cinnabar alternative described in October 2024 assessment

sections.distanceReview: The launch has been explicitly changed to the separate Cinnabar facility. The old 7-mile listing is shorter than the direct distance between these access areas, so it is withheld. A reviewed Cinnabar–Carbella river measurement is required before restoring distance or time estimates.

putInAccess.sourceName: Montana FWP — Brogan’s Landing closure proposal, Cinnabar launch alternative
putInAccess.note: FWP’s October 2024 assessment identifies Cinnabar as a USFS launch option 0.5 mile downstream of Brogan’s Landing. USFS recreation data identifies Cinnabar Picnic Area on the Yellowstone with day use only. The agency facility coordinate is approximate; no exact landing, downstream bank, or measured trip length is asserted.
putInAccess.directions: Locate the Cinnabar day-use river access on site before unloading. The marker identifies the Forest Service facility area, not a confirmed ramp or downstream bank. This is a separate site from Brogan’s Landing; check current access conditions and commercial permit requirements.

takeOutAccess.sourceName: Bureau of Land Management recreation site
takeOutAccess.note: BLM confirms a boat-access facility and publishes this recreation-site coordinate. The exact ramp edge and take-out bank remain unverified; do not substitute the facility marker for the landing.
takeOutAccess.directions: From US 89 use Tom Miner Road and the signed Carbella recreation-site entrance. Follow the boat-ramp signs inside the site; the marker is BLM’s recreation-site location.

mapAuditNote: Reviewed 2026-10-28. Corwin Springs/Brogan’s Landing identity and a still-listed flood closure prevent promotion. Queen of the Waters is not a documented boat facility. Carbella has an approximate BLM facility record. The two trips remain held.
